title: Do you guys have dreams about an aquarium?
content: I'm able to lucid dream. It was my mission on Halloween to rescue a humpback whale out of a large tank. People have told me in this community that they have not seen the whale for a while. This has excited me because I thought maybe we are share dreaming. Then I realized what if we're actually remote viewing? There is an abandoned aquarium in Miami that has animals living there. Miami Seaquarium closes, animals to be relocated https://share.google/PNzGjbSBMFFZUbf1d
